messages.subject: Pennington IBR — draft for the 18 Dec deadline
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Grace,

We're on track to deliver the final Independent Business Review by 18 December, ahead of the 19 December standstill deadline. Headline conclusions: the business is viable as a going concern subject to (a) a covenant reset to achievable levels, (b) ~£6.0m new working-capital funding, and (c) the £2.0m equity injection. Peak funding shortfall is ~£5.4m in Q1 2026. Insolvency comparator: estimated senior recoveries of 55–68p in the £. We'll address the report to Sterling under a reliance letter.

Duncan Reeves
Partner, Restructuring Advisory | Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
